response.sql:
WITH circuit_averages AS (
    SELECT
        r.circuitId,
        c.country,
        AVG(r.round) AS average_round
    FROM races AS r
    JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
    GROUP BY r.circuitId, c.country
), country_averages AS (
    SELECT
        c.country,
        AVG(r.round) AS baseline_round
    FROM races AS r
    JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
    GROUP BY c.country
)
SELECT
    ca.circuitId,
    ca.country,
    ca.average_round,
    ca.average_round - co.baseline_round AS difference_from_country_baseline
FROM circuit_averages AS ca
JOIN country_averages AS co ON ca.country = co.country
ORDER BY difference_from_country_baseline DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The country baseline is weighted by race, as requested: it averages round numbers across all races at circuits in that country. Circuits with no matching races are excluded because their average is undefined.
